metadata.case_name: CHUI WAI KAM MICHELLE v. GILLESPIE JOHN THOMAS

injuries.description: the plaintiff suffered from soft tissue injury of her neck as a result of the Accident.
source: the plaintiff suffered from soft tissue injury of her neck as a result of the Accident.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

injuries.description: X-ray showed degenerative changes in her cervical spine, and loss of lordosis.
source: X-ray showed degenerative changes in her cervical spine, and loss of lordosis.

injuries.description: retrolisthesis at the C5/6 level of her cervical spine
source: the doctors suspected that the retrolisthesis[1] at the C5/6 level of her cervical spine was caused by trauma.
injuries.icd_description: Dislocation of other specified cervical vertebra

injuries.description: There was mild to moderate degree of broad-based posterior C5/6 disc protrusion, indenting the theca and anterior cervical cord. The protruded disc was also causing left foraminal stenosis with impingement on the left C6 exiting nerve root.
source: Anterior marginal osteophytes at the C5 and C6 vertebrae were seen, with desiccation and narrowing of the C5/6 intervertebral disc, consistent with spondylosis. There was mild to moderate degree of broad-based posterior C5/6 disc protrusion, indenting the theca and anterior cervical cord. The protruded disc was also causing left foraminal stenosis with impingement on the left C6 exiting nerve root. There was mild right foraminal stenosis due to osteophytic encroachment by unco-vertebral joint marginal spur, but there was no significant impingement on the right C6 exiting nerve root.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of cervical spine

source: the plaintiff did suffer from right cubital tunnel syndrome, which caused her pain and numbness in her right upper limb.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of ulnar nerve at forearm level

injuries.description: sprain to the plaintiff’s lumbar spine
source: The sprain to the plaintiff’s lumbar spine, which contributed to her right leg pain and numbness, was not caused by the Accident.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: pain over her left neck region with burning sensation radiating down her left upper limb
active neck flexion and extension was noted to be 1/2 the normal range, and neck rotation was 1/3 the normal range
Muscle power over her right upper limb was noted to be slightly decreased
pain and numbness in her upper limbs
pain and numbness in her back and right leg
right upper limb weakness and numbness

treatments_received: occupational therapy (7 sessions between 7 October 2011 and 15 December 2011)
chiropractic treatment (Dr Simon Lee, starting from 23 April 2014 to 16 June 2014)
admitted to the orthopaedics ward at Yan Chai Hospital (24 September 2011 to 28 September 2011)
treatments_future: symptomatic treatment from time to time

comparable_cases.case_name: Leung Siu Ping v Mak Sin Yee
comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff was a receptionist, and she suffered whiplash injury as a back seat passenger in a traffic accident. She had a deep lacerated wound over her right forehead and 2 small lacerated wounds over her mid-forehead. She suffered from dizziness, headache and shoulder and neck pain.

comparable_cases.case_name: Tai Yuk Wong v Chong Kwok Fung & Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff suffered whiplash injury with neck pain and upper limb numbness for around a year. There would be residual pain and upper limb numbness.

comparable_cases.case_name: Muhammad Saddiq v Cheung Chi Keung
comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff developed pain in his neck and back after the accident. The diagnosis was sprained back and whiplash injury to the neck. The accident caused degeneration in his lumbar spine.
